header.brandTagline: Connect your mini departure display to WiFi and configure your stops.

wifi.title: WiFi Settings
wifi.step1: Scan and select a WiFi network
wifi.apNotice: The setup AP stays online at mini-config while the device joins your WiFi.
wifi.factoryResetNotice: Resets the device to factory defaults. After reboot, the WiFi must be configured again.
wifi.statusConnectionPending: WiFi connection is not successful yet. Please verify the settings.
wifi.confirmFactoryReset: Reset the device to factory defaults now?

stations.title: Stops
stations.step3: Paste the link here and name the stop
stations.limitNotice: You can store up to {{maxStations}} stops.
stations.validationError: Please fill in name and departure URL for every stop. The URL must contain the 32-character ID (https://www.vrs.de/am/s/... or ...&i=...).

power.title: Power Schedule
power.help: Choose the power mode. The update interval applies to all modes.
power.modeContinuous: Continuous mode (recommended only with USB power)
power.manualRefreshHelp: Defines how many display refreshes happen after a manual wake-up before the device returns to long deep sleep.
power.timeFormatError: Start/end must be in HH:MM format.
power.nightWindowError: Start/end must be inside the night window 22:00-06:00.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Choose whether the setup page follows your browser language or a fixed language. A manual selection also updates the device screen language.
settings.firmwareHelp: Upload a compiled firmware .bin file. The device reboots automatically after a successful update.
settings.firmwareNoFile: Please choose a firmware file first.
settings.firmwareTooLarge: The selected file is too large for the OTA slot (max {{size}}).
settings.firmwareReloadScheduled: Firmware uploaded. The page will reload automatically after the reboot.
settings.firmwareRebootPending: The device is rebooting. The page will reload automatically.

modal.title: Device Is Rebooting
modal.wifiConnectedMessage: WiFi connected. The device will now reboot and connect to your WiFi.
modal.redirectCountdown: You will be redirected to mini.local in {{seconds}} seconds.
modal.waitingMessage: Waiting for mini.local on your regular WiFi...
modal.waitingDetail: Checking the connection. This can take up to 60 seconds.
modal.rebootFailedMessage: The reboot could not be triggered.
modal.rebootFailedDetail: Please try again or use the “Reboot Device” button.
modal.unavailableDetail: Please make sure your device is on the same WiFi. You can try again.
